title: The Token-Energy Law of LLM Decode: Active Bytes and Realized Time Account for Joules per Token
abstract: arXiv:2610.28576v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Energy-efficient deployment of large language models requires understanding how model architecture, hardware, and serving settings shape energy per generated token. We introduce the Token-Energy Law, a compact, interpretable model of GPU-board energy per output token for dense, full-history decoding. It relates token energy to two core dimensions: active bytes and realized decode time. Active bytes describe logical byte demand per output, separating dense weights shared within a decode iteration from private key--value (KV) histories read and updated for each request. Realized decode time is the elapsed decode duration divided by the number of output tokens produced. We combine the two byte coordinates and time in a common affine form, with coefficients calibrated for each model and hardware/runtime configuration. translated_title: LLM解码的令牌-能量定律：活跃字节与实际时间共同解释每令牌的焦耳能耗
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的高能效部署需要理解模型架构、硬件和服务配置如何影响每个生成令牌的能耗。我们提出了令牌-能量定律，这是一个紧凑且可解释的模型，用于描述密集、全历史解码模式下GPU板卡上每个输出令牌的能量消耗。该定律将令牌能耗与两个核心维度相关联：活跃字节和实际解码时间。活跃字节描述每个输出的逻辑字节需求，将解码迭代内共享的稠密权重与每个请求各自读取和更新的私有键值历史分离开来。实际解码时间是解码总耗时除以生成的输出令牌数量。我们将这两个字节坐标与时间以统一的仿射形式结合，其系数针对每个模型和硬件/运行时配置进行校准。该公式解释了批处理如何摊销共享权重的工作量，更长的注意力历史如何增加私有KV的需求。
tldr: 提出了令牌-能量定律，用活跃字节和实际解码时间两个维度以可校准的仿射形式精确刻画LLM解码中每令牌的GPU能耗，并解释了批处理摊销与KV历史增长对能耗的影响。
en_tdlr: Introduces the Token-Energy Law, a compact interpretable affine model that accounts for per-token GPU energy in LLM decoding via two dimensions—active bytes and realized decode time—explaining how batching amortizes shared-weight work and longer KV histories increase energy demand.
